params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Every few seconds, {{cis|Gangplank}} next basic attack will burn the target, continually dealing {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} and granting him {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.blurb2: Whenever a ''{{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}'' explodes, ''Trial by Fire's'' cooldown will {{sti|ah|reset}} and '''Gangplank''' will gain the {{as|movement speed}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Gangplank''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to set the target on fire, dealing them{{ft|{{pplevel|50 to 250|color=true damage}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} over {{fd|2.5}} seconds.|{{pplevel|50/10 to 250/10|color=true damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over {{fd|2.5}} seconds.}}{{tip|turret|Turrets}} are dealt 50% damage.
params.description2: If '''Gangplank''' successfully hits a target with ''Trial by Fire'', he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pplevel|15 to 30|key=%}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds. Every time a ''{{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}'' explodes, the {{sti|cooldown}} for ''Trial by Fire'' resets and '''Gangplank''' gains its {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
params.description3: ''Trial by Fire cannot be applied with {{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}} nor {{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}.''

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Gangplank}} shoots the target enemy with his pistol, dealing {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
params.blurb2: If this attack kills the target, he gains {{g|gold}} and {{ai|Silver Serpents|Gangplank}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' fires a shot at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects as a {{tip|ranged}} attack, and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
params.description2: If ''Parrrley'' kills the target, '''Gangplank''' plunders {{g|gold}} and [[File:Silver Serpents.png|20px|link=]] ''Silver Serpents''. Each enemy killed by a ''{{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}}'' explosion that was originally set off by ''Parrrley'' also counts for the plunder.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Gold Plunder|{{g|{{ap|3 to 7}}}}}}
{{st|Silver Serpent Plunder|[[File:Silver Serpents.png|20px|link=]] {{ap|4 to 8}}}}
params.description3: [[File:Silver Serpents.png|20px|link=]] ''Silver Serpents'' can be spent while at the [[shop]] to upgrade ''{{ai|Cannon Barrage|Gangplank}}''.
params.notes:
* ''Parrrley'' deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
* {{ri|Fleet Footwork}} will always trigger its melee effect, even when it is triggered by ''Parrrley''.<!--not the case for voltaic sword for example-->
* {{tip|On-hit}} effects that deal damage to secondary targets will allow ''Parrrley'' to plunder from enemies killed that way, much like with {{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank|Powder Kegs}}.
** {{ii|Ravenous Hydra}} and {{ii|Titanic Hydra}} work like this and will grant additional plunder from enemies they kill when triggered by ''Parrrley'' as their {{tip|cast instance}}.
** Even spell effects such as {{ii|Luden's Echo}} will work with this when triggered by ''Parrrley'' as their {{tip|cast instance}}. Spell effects that do not belong to their triggering cast instance, such as {{iis|Liandry's Torment}} damage debuff, do not grant plunder for enemies they kill.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Gangplank}} eats citrus to {{tip|cleanse}} {{tip|crowd control}} effects and {{tip|heal}} based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' consumes a large quantity of citrus fruit, {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself from all {{tip|crowd control}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself.
params.notes:
* ''Remove Scurvy'' does not remove [[debuff]]s other than {{tip|crowd control}}, even if both occur from the same effect. For example, ''Remove Scurvy'' will dispel the {{tip|slow}} from {{si|Exhaust}}, but not its [[damage modifier|damage reduction]].
* ''Remove Scurvy'' can remove the underlying {{tip|stun}} from {{tip|airborne}}, but a {{tip|blink}} or {{tip|dash}} ability is required to override the displacement.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Gangplank}} places a ''Powder Keg'' at the target location, which can be {{tip|basic attack|attacked}} or {{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank|shot}} to damage it. If an enemy destroys a ''Powder Keg'', it is safely dismantled.
params.blurb2:
If '''Gangplank''' destroys a ''Powder Keg'', it will explode to deal the {{as|attack's damage|pdamage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow}} them. Against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, the explosion additionally deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and ignores a {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|portion of their armor}}}}.

The explosion will cause nearby ''Powder Kegs'' to also explode.
params.blurb3: '''Gangplank''' stocks a ''Powder Keg'' every few seconds, up to a maximum.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' consumes a charge to place a powder keg at the target location that lasts for 25 seconds and will connect to other kegs with overlapping connection radius through a trail of black powder. The keg starts with {{as|3 health}} and loses {{as|1|health}} every {{pp|2;1;0.5|1;7;13}} seconds until it is left with {{as|1 health}}.
params.description2: '''Gangplank''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Powder Keg'' charge, up to a maximum.
params.description3: Kegs can be {{tip|basic attack|attacked}} by enemies or '''Gangplank''' (including his ''{{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}}''), dealing 1 damage to it. When an enemy destroys it, it is safely defused. When '''Gangplank''' destroys it, it explodes and also triggers a chain reaction that explodes other nearby connected kegs with a {{rutngt|0.3}}-delay between explosions. The explosions also grant {{tip|sight}} of their radiuses for 2 seconds.
params.description4: Enemies caught in an explosion are dealt the triggering {{tt|{{as|attack's damage}}|see notes}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 2 seconds. Against champions, the explosion also deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. Each enemy can only be hit once per chain and the damage dealt ignores {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|40% of the target's armor}}}}.
params.description5: ''The triggering attack on the keg can {{tip|critically strike}}, causing the explosion to deal the attack's critical damage.''
params.notes:
{{safesubst:unexpected|desc= * The {{tip|slow}}, {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to champions, and keg {{as|health}} decay speed are determined when the keg is placed. ** The keg {{as|health}} decay timer indicator is instead based on '''Gangplank's''' current level, which can lead to desynchronization. [https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3rYb4Ujs17U] {{bug}}|affectedEffects=Gangplank E|estimatedPatchOrigin=V5.14|wikiUploadTimestamp=1774027850|pagename=Template:Data Gangplank/Powder Keg }} * The triggering attack's damage can include {{ais|Parrrley|Gangplank}} base damage and {{tip|Spellblade}}. * The percentage armor penetration stacks multiplicatively with other sources of percentage armor penetration. * When triggered with critical strike, ''Spellblade'' and the bonus damage to champions are added after the calculations. * [[Damage modifier]]s are applied to the damage dealt '''by''' kegs, but not to the damage dealt '''to''' kegs. * The total damage can be calculated with this formula:
{aDMG * [2 ({{ii|Infinity Edge|+ 0.30}})]} + sDMG + cDMG
Where: ** aDMG = Triggering attack's damage ** sDMG = Spellblade's damage ** cDMG = Bonus damage to champions * Kegs have special interactions with {{tip|Spellblade}}: ** If the keg destroying attack was empowered with ''Spellblade'', its damage will be added to the explosions' damage. ** If the keg was not destroyed, it will consume the effect and the keg will store the damage it would have dealt. If the storing keg is the initial detonation of the chain, it will add its damage to the explosions' damage as if it was triggered with ''Spellblade''. ** If the storing keg was attacked with a new instance of ''Spellblade'', it will override the previously stored damage (if different). ** Damage can only be stored if ''Spellblade'' was consumed by '''Gangplank'''. ** The stored damage is static and will not change if '''Gangplank's''' '''base''' attack damage or ability power (see below) changes. * Specific {{tip|Spellblade}} item interactions: ** {{ii|Bloodsong}}: Dealing damage with kegs to champions won't apply ''Expose Weakness'' to them. ** {{ii|Iceborn Gauntlet}}: The frost field will be created on the location of the keg that is attacked. ** {{ii|Lich Bane}}: The {{as|magic damage}} will be added to the explosions' damage, but will be dealt as {{as|physical damage}}. ** {{ii|Trinity Force}}: Attacking kegs grants the movespeed from {{nie|Quicken}}; dealing damage with the explosion does not since it does not trigger {{tip|on-hit}} effects. * Kegs triggering a chain reaction will show a lit fuse traveling toward other kegs. ** The lit fuse is only visual and does not affect the time it takes for kegs to explode. * Placed kegs do '''not''' grant {{tip|sight|vision}} until they explode, but they are revealed to '''Gangplank'''. ** If '''Gangplank''' loses allied vision, for instance due to {{tip|nearsight}}, he will also lose vision on his kegs temporarily. ** Kegs prematurely grant {{tip|sight}} of their explosion radius (including across terrain and into bushes) if {{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}} or a lit fuse is traveling towards them. *** This area reveal happens even if {{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}} is not going to make it explode. * An exploding ''Powder Keg'' will splash {{ais|Parrrley|Gangplank}} '''bonus''' damage, and will also be modified if the attack {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}}. * Attacks against ''Powder Kegs'' will apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects (such as {{iis|Tiamat}} {{nie|Cleave}}), but {{tip|proc damage}} against the keg itself is reduced to 0. ** Damage from [[on-hit]] effects will therefore '''not''' increase the damage of the explosion. ** {{tip|Spellblade}} is a {{tt|special-cased exception|Since late Season 9 - previously, Spellblade worked simply because it would add to the attack's damage directly}}. * ''Powder Kegs'' will take damage from effects that apply on-hit effects (eg. {{iis|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} {{nie|Seething Strike}} ), but will remain at {{as|1 health}} if they would be killed by them. * The number of ''Powder Kegs'' in stock is visible under '''Gangplank's''' [[health bar]] for all players. * '''Gangplank''' stocks ''Powder Kegs'' even if the ability hasn't been learned yet. ** This is due to the recharge rate at level 1 being set the same as level 0. ** While at maximum charges, ranking up the ability to rank 3 or 5 grants the remaining charge immediately regardless of the recharge timer. * If a keg is destroyed during the {{rutngt|0.3}}-delay between explosions, '''Gangplank''' will plunder {{g|gold}} and ''{{ai|Silver Serpents|Gangplank}}'' upon killing enemies as if he had done so using {{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}}.{{bug|1}} ** This effect persists through {{tip|death}} and will only end upon killing an enemy with {{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Gangplank}} orders a cannon bombardment to the target location, each blast deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within.
params.blurb2: '''Gangplank''' can improve ''Cannon Barrage'' by purchasing upgrades in the shop with {{ai|Silver Serpents|Gangplank}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gangplank''' shoots a flare into the air, signaling his ship off-shore to fire upon the target location, calling down 12 waves of cannonballs in clusters of 3 every 2 seconds, each wave in a cluster hitting {{fd|0.25}} seconds after the other, and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for the duration. Each wave deals {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within the area and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 30% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
params.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage Per Wave|{{ap|40 to 100}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Cluster|{{ap|40*3 to 100*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*3}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|40*12 to 100*12}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*12}}% AP)}}}}
params.description2: While within the [[shop]] area, '''Gangplank''' can purchase upgrades for his ship at the cost of 500 ''{{ai|Silver Serpents|Gangplank}}'' each, which improve ''Cannon Barrage'' with new effects:
params.description3: {{sbc|{{ii|Death's Daughter}}:}} A large cannonball lands in the center of the barrage after the first cluster of waves occur, dealing a cluster's worth of {{as|true damage}} to enemies within the impact and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 75% for 1 second.
params.leveling3:
{{st|True Damage with {{ii|Death's Daughter}}|{{ap|40*3 to 100*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*3}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Mixed Damage with {{ii|Death's Daughter}}|{{ap|40*12+40*3 to 100*12+100*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*12+10*3}}% AP)}}}}
params.description4: {{sbc|{{ii|Fire at Will}}:}} ''Cannon Barrage'' fires{{ft|6 additional waves|2 additional clusters}}over its duration; 18 waves of cannonballs are called down in clusters of 3 every {{fd|1.3{{recurring|3}}}} seconds.
params.leveling4:
{{st|Total Magic Damage with {{ii|Fire at Will}}|{{ap|40*18 to 100*18}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*18}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Maximum Mixed Total Damage with {{ii|Fire at Will}} and {{ii|Death's Daughter}}|{{ap|40*18+40*3 to 100*18+100*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*18+10*3}}% AP)}}}}
params.description5: {{sbc|{{ii|Raise Morale}}:}} ''Cannon Barrage'' grants '''Gangplank''' and all allies within the area {{sti|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, lingering for 2 seconds.
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|580|Volley damage and Raise Morale effect radius}}
params.notes:
* '''Gangplank's''' upgrades for ''Cannon Barrage'' are offered through a special menu in the HUD which is only visible while inside the area eligible for accessing the shop. Within the special menu, the player can purchase an upgrade by {{LMB}} clicking on its portrait or via the Champion Specific Interaction [[hotkey]]s (default: {{sbc|Shift}}+{{sbc|F1–F3}}).
** Purchased upgrades have a trim around their portrait. Upgrades that he does not have enough currency to purchase are greyed out.
* ''Cannon Barrage's'' slow lingers for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after affected enemies leave the target area.
* If an Attack order is issued and is being cycled through casting ''Cannon Barrage'', and no other order is issued after casting it, '''Gangplank's''' next basic attack is delayed by 1 second.
